qualitative_updates.note: No new cross-chart entries were counted today because every chart in the 2026-10-10 snapshot is flagged partial (public lists only); the uc->tt (17), te->tt (11) and tt->mp (10) counts are unchanged.

Sell Fries! [Anomaly] stays among the best Up-and-Coming holders and simulation_job keeps a high median percentile there (63); still no Anomaly game on Most Popular, so the 'durable genre' part is untested.

Today's profiles added more duel/arena shooters on Up-and-Coming and Top Earning (Archer, ONE TAP PISTOLS, Knife VS Gun DUELS, [FPS] FLING) that lean on rolls, cases and skins rather than passes; combat_pvp is now the largest profiled loop on Top Earning (32, median percentile 60).
